Cubans Fall Victim to Armed Robbery After Entering Car in Guyana

Formerly enslaved people in Guyana embraced collective action

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Guyana's oil boom has created a need for foreign workers, as discussed in the context of migration policy. [2]
Cubans in Guyana have fallen victim to armed robbery after entering a car. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GUYANA
The need for foreign workers due to the oil boom may be complicated by the 12 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations linked to Guyana. [2][E2]

KEY RISKS
The most severe government travel advisory for Guyana is Reconsider Travel, indicating elevated risk for visitors. [E1]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen how the migration policy will address the need for foreign workers amid the oil boom. [2]
